headline: Wheeler's shutout lifts Phillies past Nationals, 3-0
recap: The Phillies' most recent game was Wednesday's 3-0 win at Washington. Trea Turner, Bryce Harper and Luis Arraez all walked to load the bases in the first, and Alec Bohm's single scored Turner before Bryson Stott's bases-loaded walk brought home Harper, putting Philadelphia up 2-0. Harper led off the seventh with a single and scored on Luis Arraez's double off reliever Richard Lovelady, making it 3-0. Zack Wheeler allowed no runs over seven innings with five strikeouts and a walk to improve to 13-5; José Alvarado worked a scoreless eighth for the hold and Jhoan Duran closed it out for his 31st save. Nationals starter Jared Simpson was charged with the loss after issuing four walks and allowing both first-inning runs in just a third of an inning.
The Phillies are 84-68, second in the NL East, 4.5 games behind the division-leading Braves, and have won one straight.

Philadelphia opens a four-game series at the Mets tonight, with first pitch scheduled for 7:15 PM ET at Citi Field. Aaron Nola starts for the Phillies opposite Nolan McLean for New York; DraftKings lists the Mets as -132 favorites over the Phillies at +109.
